Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I've owned many gas grills in my day. Many were purchased because they were cheap. Cheap is as cheap does (i.e. you often get what you pay for). Our average cheap grill life was 2 years. 

With our Weber we ponied up a bit more cash and the differences are astonishing. They are well engineered and feel solid (even the lid has bumpers to eliminate the clank). The battery powered electric start is great, the built in LP tank gauge is ingenious, and the overall look and feel is worth every penny.  

I look for it to last much longer than 2 years. As far as ease of use, even the wife likes it!
Results.Title: The best grill I've owned

Results.ReviewText: I bought this from Lowe's about 1 month ago.  I was eager to assemble it so we could host family from out of town. The Spirit II E-210 is smaller than our previous grill but works great for our needs.  The grill is very well designed and robust.  I'd buy it again.    The link to the assembly video was very valuable.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
